intro.text: A spren who appears as a creeping crystal-studded vine, bonded to the young thief Lift in Azimir.
A cultivationspren and gardener of chairs, bonded to Lift and so making her an Edgedancer.

items.text: Wyndle was a gardener in the Cognitive Realm, gathering the souls of chairs and growing them into crystals. The Ring asked him to bond Lift, a choice he neither liked nor understood.

On the night the Azish chose a new Prime, Wyndle went with Lift and a gang of thieves to rob the palace. Lift used him to climb walls and spy, and he taught her to use Progression to grow plants and pop open a window, though he didn't think her ready for Regrowth.

When Darkness caught Lift, Wyndle coached her escape. One of Darkness's followers killed Gawx, and Lift went back for him. Doubtful she could manage it, Wyndle told her about Regrowth; she swore her Second Ideal and healed Gawx, who was taken for a miracle-worker and made Prime. He pardoned Lift, and Darkness had to let her go.
Wyndle was happy as a guest of honour at the palace, but he followed Lift to Yeddaw without understanding her plans, working out on the way that they were following Darkness.
In Yeddaw, Lift used Wyndle to climb and spy. When Darkness arrived, Wyndle learned from Lift that he planned to kill Radiants.

Trailing Darkness through a market, they saw him kill a thief with his Shardblade. Wyndle explained that a Shardblade kills faster than Lift's powers can heal. They followed Darkness to his quarters, where Lift ate his pancakes.

Wyndle got Lift into the Grand Indicium, where he formed a word for her to copy and show the scribes, who checked with Gawx and were told to help her. He then spied on one of Darkness's allies and learned an execution was about to take place.

Confronting Darkness, Lift spoke her Third Ideal and Wyndle became a silvery rod, a Shardweapon strong enough to block Darkness's Honorblade. She used the moment to convince him the Desolation had returned.
Wyndle and Lift went back to Azir to prepare for what was coming, where the Prime came to trust Lift's advice.

Lift stayed to fight at Thaylen City, tasked by Dalinar with taking the King's Drop from a Fused using Abrasion. Wyndle followed the faster Fused. When a thunderclast hit Lift, he urged her to summon him as a weapon; she made a rod, but Szeth saved her. Together they got the ruby to Dalinar.

Over the following year, Wyndle and Lift stayed at Urithiru, joining a dozen or so new Edgedancers in healing on the battlefields. Dalinar turned down Lift's request to join the envoy to the honorspren.

Just before the Fused took Urithiru, Wyndle got Lift to admit that Gift left food out for her and that her powers came from Cultivation. When the Radiants were suppressed, he could no longer become a weapon. Mraize caged them and sold them to the Fused; Wyndle went for help but did not return until the tower was freed.

appearance.text: Wyndle appears as a vine with clear crystal structures, which grows towards where he wants to go rather than moving. His vines harden into crystal and crumble to dust behind him, and he can curl them into a face. Usually only Lift can see him.
Since Lift swore her Third Ideal, he can become a Shardweapon, so far taking the form of a metal rod and a fork.

personality.text: Wyndle didn't choose Lift and is frustrated by her unwillingness to learn, but he cares for her and worries she isn't eating enough.
A proper, intelligent gardener who loves a quiet life, Wyndle is very proud of the chairs he has grown, and is cautious and nervous about Lift's odd behaviour.
He sees encouraging Lift to speak the Immortal Words as his duty, and their bond improves as he learns to understand what she really means.
He doesn't like being used to hurt people.
